status.evidence: According to the UK Companies House registry, GTrak Ltd (Company number 06990564) is currently active and registered at an address in Ossett.

claims.claim: The company reports 5G connectivity support within its hardware line, specifically featured in its GTrak Live View Connected DashCams which integrate into the FleetPro Plus Fleet Management System, as detailed on the GTrak official website (https://gtrak.co.uk/fleet-management-system/dashcam-live-view/).

The company reports that its FleetPro Plus software provides integrated real-time tracking, a customizable reporting suite with over 20 reports tracking idling and mileage, and a Driver ID key fob system for monitoring behavior such as acceleration and braking.
claims.note: The reporting tracking details "over 20 reports tracking idling and mileage" and monitoring of behavior like "acceleration and braking" could not be verified on the company website; the suite mentions 20+ reports, idling, mileage, and driver behavior analysis generally, but not those exact phrasing combinations or parameters.

claims.claim: The company reports integrated hardware add-ons including its GTrak Live View Connected DashCams featuring 5G connectivity, 1080p dual forward/cab-facing cameras, anti-tamper technology, and integrated Driver ID key fobs.
claims.note: The specific feature "dual forward/cab-facing" (the website states "1080p Forward and Cab Facing Camera" without the word "dual") and the description of the integrated Driver ID key fobs being built into the dashcam hardware add-on could not be verified as a combined hardware specification from the available source.

claims.claim: An annual revenue estimate of $600,000 for 2026, as reported in a third-party corporate profile by RocketReach.

The company reports having two UK offices ensuring national coverage alongside an in-house customer support team, as stated on Approved Business (https://www.approvedbusiness.co.uk/companies/gtrak-ltd).
claims.corrected: The company reports having two UK offices ensuring national coverage alongside an excellent ongoing support team, as stated on Approved Business (https://www.approvedbusiness.co.uk/companies/gtrak-ltd).

claims.claim: The company claims to provide 24/7 technical support alongside its tracking software and advanced features to ensure system reliability, as reported on the GTrak Asset Tracking Documentation (https://gtrak.co.uk/fleet-management-system/vehicle-tracking/asset-tracking/).
